text: Staking, withdrawing, and rewards are all written -- but none of it has been proven yet. This lesson builds the real Hardhat test suite.
Desmond organizes tests by feature: staking, withdrawing, reward distribution, and claiming -- each with the normal expected cases and the obvious reverts.
Every claim test runs against ordinary wallet accounts -- the same kind of address any real EmberStake user connects with.
All nine tests pass, coverage looks solid across every function, and the team feels genuinely confident heading toward testnet.
Next: building the indexer and REST API the frontend will use to read stakes and rewards.
